subject: Insurance endorsement + PO/invoice routing for Kinetic Edge onboarding
messages:
From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@kineticedge.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Onboarding docs — COI and tax form attached

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for walking us through the onboarding checklist earlier. Attached are the COI and our W-9 so we can move forward with PO creation. A couple quick asks from our side: can you confirm who we should put on the invoice as the remit-to address, and is there any special PO field we need to include to avoid payment delays?

Also, your procurement team mentioned Redwood requires an endorsement for Additional Insured + Waiver of Subrogation and that the wording needs to reference Redwood Inference, Inc. as the certificate holder. If you can send the exact endorsement language you need, we'll get our carrier to issue an endorsed COI.

Attachments: KineticEdge_COI_2026.pdf (certificate), W9_KineticEdge.pdf (tax form)

Thanks,

Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and for sending the COI + W-9. Looping in Rishi (procurement) and Lauren (AP) to confirm the endorsement language and invoice routing.

Quick answers:
- Remit-to for invoices: AP team prefers invoices to be emailed to ap@redwood.com and PDF invoice must include PO number in the subject and on the body.
- PO creation: we will issue a PO once the endorsed COI is received and the vendor setup is complete in our system.

Rishi / Lauren — can one of you confirm the exact endorsement wording we require so Alex can take to his carrier? Also flag any other missing fields on their W-9 that would block PO issuance.

Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

Forwarded attachment summary: KineticEdge_COI_2026.pdf, W9_KineticEdge.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Alex Torres <alex.torres@kineticedge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Onboarding docs — COI and tax form attached

Hi Alex / Stephanie —

Thanks for sending these — reviewed the COI and W-9 quickly. W-9 looks complete. COI shows general liability but does not yet include the endorsement language we require. Please ask your carrier or broker to add the following as an endorsement on the COI (exact text below):

"Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are additional insured with respect to Commercial General Liability under a primary and non-contributory basis. Waiver of subrogation applies where permitted by law.

Certificate holder:
Redwood Inference, Inc.
1219 Market St, Suite 300
San Francisco, CA 94103"

We also require the carrier name and policy numbers to be listed on the certificate (they were present), and limits to meet our minimums (Commercial General Liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate; Excess/Umbrella: $5,000,000). If your COI already lists limits below that, please confirm whether higher limits are available or if a liability carryover applies.

Once the endorsed COI is uploaded, we will:
- Create the vendor record in our procurement system
- Issue a PO and send the PO number to ap@redwood.com for invoice routing

Alex — to speed things up, if you can get the carrier to send the endorsed COI via DocuSign (or email) to rishi_malhotra@redwood.com and cc ap@redwood.com, that will let us create the PO the same day we receive it.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachment: sample_endorsement_text.txt (included above in-line)

From: Alex Torres <alex.torres@kineticedge.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Next steps from our side:
- We will email AP the invoice when PO is issued (finance@kineticedge.com will be the sender).
- Please confirm the PO number when it is available so we can include it on the invoice and avoid payment exceptions.
